Name: BeaverBuddies Co-Op/PvP Edition
Description:
Multiplayer for Timberborn. This is my fork of [url=https://github.com/thomaswp/BeaverBuddies]BeaverBuddies by thomaswp[/url]: the same co-op, plus matchmaking, joining games in progress, and PvP with mods like [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3814012422]Timber Empires[/url].

[h2]What's different from the original[/h2]
[list]
[*]Find a match with anyone over Steam, list open matches to join, and invite friends without the Steam overlay.
[*]Join a game that has already started.
[*]After a desync everyone reloads from the host's save without leaving the game, and Steam games reconnect on their own.
[*]Pick a multiplayer mode when you host: co-op, or the PvE and PvP modes mods add.
[*]Game rules are picked under Customize when you create a game, and saved with it.
[*]Player cursors, synced dev tools, and faster simulation in big settlements.
[/list]

[h2]Installing[/h2]
It replaces the original BeaverBuddies, with the same mod ID: unsubscribe from the original or turn it off. Everyone in a game needs this edition, in the same version.

Ports, firewalls and other connection problems are covered in the original's [url=https://github.com/thomaswp/BeaverBuddies/wiki/Installation-and-Running#troubleshooting]troubleshooting guide[/url].

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
Post them on the [url=https://discord.gg/J9u64PRGyC]Discord[/url], with your Player.log:
[list]
[*]Windows: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Mechanistry\Timberborn\Player.log
[*]Mac: ~/Library/Logs/Mechanistry/Timberborn/Player.log
[/list]
After a desync, press Report on Discord in its dialog: it saves a trace next to Player.log to post with it.
